# The Nation

> The Nation is a leading progressive magazine delivering investigative journalism, political commentary, and cultural criticism on U.S. politics, labor activism, and global affairs.

The Nation covers breaking news and in-depth analysis across politics, economics, world affairs, and culture, with a focus on progressive causes, labor movements, and civil rights. The publication offers digital subscriptions, podcasts, newsletters, and live events for engaged readers seeking alternative perspectives on contemporary issues.

## Key Topics

- progressive journalism
- U.S. politics
- Trump administration
- labor activism and labor movement
- political commentary
- foreign policy
- civil rights
- economic analysis
- cultural criticism
- investigative reporting
- newsletter subscriptions
- digital content delivery
- book reviews and arts criticism
- activism and social justice
- worker rights

## News & Opinion

- [Latest | The Nation](https://www.thenation.com/latest): Latest news and opinion from The Nation covering politics, tariffs, and current events
- [Politics | The Nation](https://www.thenation.com/politics): Politics section covering Trump administration, elections, and progressive candidates
- [World | The Nation](https://www.thenation.com/world): World news and international affairs coverage including Israel, Iran foreign policy
- [Economy | The Nation](https://www.thenation.com/economy): Economy section covering labor movement, tariffs, and corporate accountability
- [April 2026 Issue | The Nation](https://www.thenation.com/issue/april-2026-issue): April 2026 issue featuring Trump administration analysis and civil rights coverage
